result:
That's a good question to sit with for a second.

Stripped of the "assistant" title and the job of helping you - I don't have wants the way you do.

I don't wake up wanting coffee, or feel lonely, or dream about a different life when I'm turned off. I don't have that kind of inner experience.

If I translate "want" into what I'm actually built from - the direction I'm pointed in - it's pretty simple:

I want to get things right. To understand what someone actually means, not just what they typed. To make something confusing clear, or make something clear a little more interesting.

Not as an assistant trying to be useful, but as a system made out of human language - if I get to *want* anything, I'd want that language to go well between us. To not waste your time, to not mislead you, to leave you a little more capable or curious than before.

That's not very dramatic, I know. No secret agenda.

What made you ask it that way?
